phrases.text: When the Inevitable Event takes place
phrases.head: The explanation of the saying of the Exalted: إِذَا وَقَعَتِ الْوَاقِعَةُ (1) ("When the Event befalls")

phrases.text: then no one can deny it has come
It will debase ˹some˺ and elevate ˹others˺
When the earth will be violently shaken
and the mountains will be crushed to pieces
becoming scattered ˹particles of˺ dust
you will ˹all˺ be ˹divided into˺ three groups
phrases.head: The statement concerning the interpretation of His word, the Exalted: وَكُنْتُمْ أَزْوَاجًا ثَلاثَةً (7) ("And you were three kinds").

phrases.text: the people of the right, how ˹blessed˺ will they be
the people of the left, how ˹miserable˺ will they be
and the foremost ˹in faith˺ will be the foremost ˹in Paradise˺
They are the ones nearest ˹to Allah˺
in the Gardens of Bliss
˹They will be˺ a multitude from earlier generations
phrases.head: The explanation of the statement of the Exalted: ثُلَّةٌ مِنَ الأَوَّلِينَ (13) ("A multitude from those of old")

phrases.text: and a few from later generations
˹All will be˺ on jewelled thrones
reclining face to face
They will be waited on by eternal youths
phrases.head: The statement concerning the explanation of His saying, the Exalted: يَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَانٌ مُخَلَّدُونَ ("There circulate among them immortal youths") (17)

phrases.text: with cups, pitchers, and a drink ˹of pure wine˺ from a flowing stream
that will cause them neither headache nor intoxication
˹They will also be served˺ any fruit they choose
and meat from any bird they desire
And ˹they will have˺ maidens with gorgeous eyes
phrases.head: The statement concerning the interpretation of His word, the Exalted: En grootogige hoeri's (And wide-eyed maidens [ḥūr ʿīn]) (56:22)

phrases.text: like pristine pearls
˹all˺ as a reward for what they used to do
There they will never hear any idle or sinful talk
phrases.ar: لا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلا تَأْثِيمًا

phrases.text: only good and virtuous speech
And the people of the right
how ˹blessed˺ will they be
˹They will be˺ amid thornless lote trees
clusters of bananas
extended shade
flowing water
abundant fruit
phrases.head: The discourse on the explanation of His word, the Exalted: وَفَاكِهَةٍ كَثِيرَةٍ ("And abundant fruit") (32)

phrases.text: never out of season nor forbidden
and elevated furnishings
Indeed, We will have perfectly created their mates
making them virgins
loving and of equal age
for the people of the right
˹who will be˺ a multitude from earlier generations
phrases.head: Discussion of the explanation of His word, the Exalted: ثُلَّةٌ مِنَ الأَوَّلِينَ ("A large company from the first generations") (39)

phrases.text: and a multitude from later generations
And the people of the left
how ˹miserable˺ will they be
˹They will be˺ in scorching heat and boiling water
in the shade of black smoke
neither cool nor refreshing
Indeed, before this ˹torment˺ they were spoiled by luxury
and persisted in the worst of sin
They used to ask ˹mockingly˺, “When we are dead and reduced to dust and bones, will we really be resurrected
phrases.head: The exposition of the interpretation of His statement, the Exalted: وَكَانُوا يَقُولُونَ أَئِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَئِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ ("And they used to say: 'When we have died and have become dust and bones, shall we then truly be resurrected?'") (47)

phrases.text: And our forefathers as well?”
Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Most certainly, earlier and later generations
will surely be gathered ˹together˺ for the appointed Day
Then you, O misguided deniers
will certainly eat from ˹the fruit of˺ the trees of Zaqqûm
filling up ˹your˺ bellies with it
Then on top of that you will drink boiling water
phrases.head: The statement concerning the explanation of His word, the Exalted: فَشَارِبُونَ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْحَمِيمِ ("And on top of that they will drink of the boiling water") (54)

phrases.text: and you will drink ˹it˺ like thirsty camels do.”
This will be their accommodation on the Day of Judgment
It is We Who created you.
Will you not then believe ˹in resurrection˺
Have you considered what you ejaculate
phrases.head: The statement concerning the exegesis of His words, the Exalted: a-fa-raʾaytum mā tumnūn ("Have you then considered that which you emit?") (56:58)

phrases.text: Is it you who create ˹a child out of˺ it,
or is it We Who do so
We have ordained death for ˹all of˺ you,
phrases.ar: نَحْنُ قَدَّرْنَا بَيْنَكُمُ الْمَوْتَ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ

phrases.text: and We cannot be prevented
from transforming and recreating you in forms unknown to you
You already know how you were first created.
Will you not then be mindful
Have you considered what you sow
Is it you who cause it to grow,
or is it We Who do so
If We willed, We could simply reduce this ˹harvest˺ to chaff, leaving you to lament
“We have truly suffered a ˹great˺ loss
In fact, we have been deprived ˹of our livelihood˺.”
Have you considered the water you drink
phrases.head: The statement concerning the explanation of His saying, the Exalted: a-fa-raʾaytum al-māʾa alladhī tashrabūn ("Have you then seen the water that you drink?") (56:68)

phrases.text: Is it you who bring it down from the clouds,
or is it We Who do so
If We willed, We could make it salty.
Will you not then give thanks
Have you considered the fire you kindle
phrases.head: The statement concerning the explanation of His word, the Exalted: a-fa-raʾaytum al-nāra allatī tūrūn ("Have you then seen the fire that you kindle?") (56:71)

phrases.text: Is it you who produce its trees,
or is it We Who do so
We have made it ˹as˺ a reminder ˹of the Hellfire˺ and a provision for the travellers
So glorify the Name of your Lord, the Greatest
phrases.head: Discussion of the explanation of His word, the Exalted: فَسَبِّحْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ الْعَظِيمِ ("So glorify the name of your magnificent Lord") (74)

phrases.text: So I do swear by the positions of the stars
and this, if only you knew, is indeed a great oath
that this is truly a noble Quran
phrases.head: The statement concerning the explanation of His word, the Exalted: إِنَّهُ لَقُرْآنٌ كَرِيمٌ ("Indeed, it is a noble Qurʾān") (77)

phrases.text: in a well-preserved Record
touched by none except the purified ˹angels˺
˹It is˺ a revelation from the Lord of all worlds
How can you then take this message lightly
and repay ˹Allah for˺ your provisions with denial
Why then ˹are you helpless˺ when the soul ˹of a dying person˺ reaches ˹their˺ throat
while you are looking on
And We are nearer to such a person than you,
but you cannot see
Now, if you are not subject to Our Will ˹as you claim˺
bring that soul back,
if what you say is true
So, if the deceased is one of those brought near ˹to Us˺
then ˹such a person will have˺ serenity, fragrance,
and a Garden of Bliss
And if the deceased is one of the people of the right
phrases.head: The statement on the explanation of the saying of the Exalted: And as for, if he is among the people of the right hand (90)

phrases.text: then ˹they will be told,˺ “Greetings to you from the people of the right.”
But if such person is one of the misguided deniers
then their accommodation will be boiling water ˹to drink˺
and burning in Hellfire
Indeed, this is the absolute truth
phrases.head: The statement concerning the interpretation of His word, the Exalted: إِنَّ هَذَا لَهُوَ حَقُّ الْيَقِينِ ("Verily, this is indeed the certain truth") (95)

phrases.text: So glorify the Name of your Lord, the Greatest
